banking_policies.title: Suspicious Transaction & Cross-Border Reporting
rules: Any cross-border transfer exceeding €10,000 must undergo Level-2 Sanctions screening against OFAC, EU, and UN lists.
Transactions flagged with high velocity (more than 3 transfers to new beneficiaries within 1 hour) require automated account restriction until identity re-verification.
No executive summary or report may recommend processing transactions involving unverified PEPs (Politically Exposed Persons) without Senior Compliance Officer sign-off.

banking_policies.title: Basel III Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR)
rules: The minimum acceptable Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) is 105%. If projected liquidity drops below 110%, an early warning capital buffer alert must be triggered.
Tier 1 Common Equity ratio (CET1) must remain above 12.5% across all quarterly portfolio forecasts.
Commercial loan concentration to commercial real estate (CRE) must not exceed 25% of total regulatory capital.

banking_policies.title: Automated Advisory and Fiduciary Disclaimers
rules: All AI-generated market summaries and financial research notes must explicitly state: 'This document is generated for institutional analytical purposes and does not constitute formal investment advice.'
Financial forecasts must cite verified data sources (audited 10-K, 10-Q, or central bank releases). Hallucinated metrics or unverified predictions are strictly non-compliant.
Customer personally identifiable information (PII) including account numbers, IBANs, and national IDs must be masked (e.g. ****1234) before parsing.

mock_earnings_reports.summary: Strong net interest income expansion driven by deposit repricing and robust Irish retail banking loan demand. Asset quality remains resilient with CET1 capital ratio at 15.8%, well above regulatory minimums.
Solid commercial performance across Ireland and UK retail portfolios. Full year operating profit reached €1.94B, benefiting from higher loan margins and growth in business banking originations.
